interpretation: GHZ = (|0^8>+|1^8>)/sqrt2 measured after H on all eight qubits is uniform over the 128 even-parity 8-bit strings; a 128-row table with zero odd-parity entries therefore certifies <X^8> = 1. The row count is itself the signature: a decohered or broken GHZ would populate odd-parity outcomes and show 256 rows.
verdict: passes the GHZ X-basis parity certificate at the level of the row census
